Triceps pushdown already loads the elbow only lightly, and no other triceps exercise in the library is easier on it. So I'd skip direct triceps work today instead of swapping.

⚠️ Your presses still use the triceps, so keep the weight comfortable and stay pain-free. If the elbow pain is sharp or lingers, stop and see a professional.
